# Generated by workspace/agot_inner_circle_revoke_cost. Redefines only the three
# shared court position prestige revoke costs so the Inner Circle dynasty perk
# delivers the free dismissal its description promises. Must load after A Game of
# Thrones.

minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost = {
	value = 25
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = this
			has_character_flag = temporary_court_position_cost_removal
		}
		multiply = 0
	}
	# fp2_coterie_legacy_1 - house members are dismissed without a prestige cost.
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = this
			dynasty ?= { has_dynasty_perk = fp2_coterie_legacy_1 }
			any_court_position_holder = {
				exists = dynasty
				house = prev.house
			}
		}
		multiply = {
			value = 0
			desc = inner_circle_salary_mod
		}
	}
}
